title: The AudioContext's life and the once-a-second audio watchdog
oneLine: One audio context through suspended, interrupted, detached and closed; a watchdog wakes, listens and rebuilds it.
topConcern: _whenRunning callbacks fire against the NEW context when the old one closes; _rebuildContext's hand-kept reset list already misses several fields.

title: iOS audio-session reclaim and the first-tap kick
oneLine: Return events arm a session reclaim or a 20 s kick; the next gesture fires it.
topConcern: A refused silent-WAV claim re-arms after the context was already rebuilt: two full rebuilds and re-decodes per return.

title: Zone music: which place's track is playing
oneLine: _currentZoneAmbient plus url, in-flight flag, epoch and source track the zone track across fetch, hold, deck and decode.
topConcern: No restart entry point: six callers null _currentZoneAmbient to force one, so each runs the zone-leave side effects too.

title: The session track (login theme) and its duck under a zone track
oneLine: Start-once session track with an 8 s starting guard, decoded or streamed, ducked under zone tracks.
topConcern: 'A zone owns the music' is computed two ways (zone table vs sticky _globalMusicDucked); a failed zone fetch can leave the decoded theme at 0.

title: The zone track's fetch held behind the loading gate
oneLine: Open/armed/holding latch parks one zone-track fetch until the preload settles or 20 s pass.
topConcern: An older gate's settle closure opens a newer gate's hold early (no identity check).

title: The music deck: one streamed audio element and what it should play
oneLine: One <audio> deck with tokens, pending url, stop fade, gesture wait, proof watch and zone/session/dance wants.
topConcern: A single 5 s silent-tap window turns streaming off for the session (decoded fallback, +23-40 MB); _danceWant survives _rebuildContext.

title: A land's air (ZONE_AMBIENT loop) torn down and re-decoded on a same-zone restart
oneLine: The zoneamb-<land> loop starts on entry, frees its buffer on leave, and rides startZoneAmbient's call.
topConcern: A same-zone restart (tab return, unmute, watchdog) runs the leave branch: birdsong, lava or wind cut, refetched, re-decoded and restarted from the top.

title: The sound gate: no world sound under the loading screen or a veil
oneLine: DOM-observed closed/pending/open gate with a reason, a 60 s loading failsafe, and parked loops.
topConcern: Music is gated only through the deck; on the decoded fallback the session and zone tracks play under the loading screen again.

title: Managed sound loops (sizzle, reel, river, the air, beds)
oneLine: Keyed idempotent loops that callers ensure every frame and stop when their condition lapses.
topConcern: The ensure-every-frame contract is the only recovery after _rebuildContext; the once-started zone air has none of its own.

title: A sound's decode life: bytes held, decoding, decoded, evicted (the sound cache)
oneLine: Per-key sample phases across six maps: file bytes, in-flight decode, decoded pinned or LRU, evicted, cold play.
topConcern: Rebuild resets _samples but not _tagLoads/_sampleTag/_sampleLoadP; one refused low-rate decode doubles every later voice's memory for the session.

title: Asks remembered before there is a context: manifest, combat sounds, the Wheel's ground steps
oneLine: Latches remember sound loads asked before the first gesture; unlock() replays them once a page.
topConcern: After any context rebuild (every iOS app switch) the Wheel's ten ground clips are never reloaded: dirt steps and fallback hit/prop voices until re-entry.

title: Menu sounds: one voice a key, and the generic click that yields to a named one
oneLine: Per-key last-voice slot with a 260 ms window, and a 60 ms deferred click that yields to named sounds.
topConcern: A named sound dropped by the 260 ms window never stamps _uiSpecificAt, so the pending generic click plays instead.

title: The voice cap: at most 3 copies of one recording start within 50 ms
oneLine: Per-key sliding window of start times that holds back crowd copies of one recording.

title: Sample round-robins: which swing, hit, step or stroke plays next
oneLine: Eight counters and last-one slots alternate samples and detunes for swings, hits, steps, strokes, props.
topConcern: propHit's fallback shares _swordHitToggle with materialHit, breaking the promised strict two-step alternation (cosmetic).

title: Mute, the two sliders, and the Sound Studio's music preview
oneLine: muted, musicLevel and sfxLevel drive two bus gains; the studio preview writes the music bus directly.
topConcern: A slider move, mute or rebuild during a studio preview restores the music bus under the preview; skateRollDemo never disconnects its nodes.

title: The procedural drone and combat intensity (dormant since v2.3.1103)
oneLine: Oscillator drone nodes only ever nulled; setCombatIntensity still called each combat frame and no-ops.

title: NPC_DATA: the seed record of every townsperson's routine
oneLine: Rows seed alive, hp, timers, targets and quest marker that BroTown's AI loop mutates on shallow copies.
topConcern: Client-only townsfolk death and respawn path is unreachable only because every row sets noHp; shallow copies share nested arrays.

title: Which worker generation the page predicts against (caps flags)
oneLine: About a dozen module flags mirror state_sync caps, rewritten together each sync; prog3Live needs cap and blob.
topConcern: Move speed and reach are client-consumed by design; the worker bounds rather than computes them.

title: ZONES as a live table: the Wheel's size and the dungeons' synthetic rows
oneLine: ZONES.wheel geometry set from caps; dungeon rows inserted on start, dropped by four exit paths.
topConcern: A Wheel dungeon's row is deleted by a 1.5 s timer that checks only the id; re-entering the same instance inside it loses the row.

title: One zone-blocker hook shared by the Wheel, the farm and the arena
oneLine: Single blocker-hook slot installed by whichever world is drawn; its disposer clears only its own.

title: Wheel townsfolk and halls gated by worker caps: halls every sync, townsfolk at spawn
oneLine: One table gates halls (re-read every state_sync) and cap-needing townsfolk (decided once at spawn).
topConcern: A reconnect to a worker with different caps re-gates halls but keeps the spawned Woodworker, Farmer or Beastmaster until a zone change.

title: Pets: the page's mirror of the worker's pet book
oneLine: Display copies of the pet trade hold, XP curve and wire parse; the worker decides everything.
topConcern: With pettrade off the worker answers 'off', which TRAP_WORDS words as trapping resting; petTradeView keeps offering.

title: Monster phases the page treats as nothing to hit (burrow pile, swell deadline)
oneLine: isIntangible reads _burstUntil and _burPhase, written by events, ticks and the renderer's expiry.
topConcern: The page tests !!_burstUntil where the worker tests now < _burstUntil; a missed execute leaves a monster untouchable past its deadline.

title: A gather node's seed: alive, hp, respawnAt and a 2-minute respawn the worker does not use
oneLine: createGatherNode seeds a node's alive, harvested, respawn machine; guards read respawnAt on the page clock.
topConcern: Seed predicts a 120 s revive while the worker revives at 20 s; a lost deplete echo leaves the node greyed for 2 minutes.

title: Lil Bro's tally of races won off you
oneLine: Module counter of races lost, bumped by race_end, read by his next line; memory only.
topConcern: The count is the page's, not the character's: another character in the same tab inherits it.

title: The monster codex's unlock thresholds
oneLine: Static thresholds for the worker's kill-count codex pages; all facts open at one kill.

title: Animation timelines declared in this slice (level-up burst, zone banner, auras, stage looks)
oneLine: Frame and beat tables with pure frame-at-time readers driving visual machines elsewhere.

title: Cosmetic masks: owned list and the one worn (dormant)
oneLine: MASKS and drawMask describe a worn-mask cosmetic; nothing writes rpg._activeMask and nothing calls drawMask.
